names.note: The day's line prints the name in Latin letters, «Άγιος Cadoc»; the Greek form is the gloss his own page gives, «Ο Άγιος Cadoc (Κάντοκ)».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Ιανουαρίου — «Άγιος Cadoc»

attestations.note: saint.gr gives him the bare title Άγιος and does not call him abbot, although it says he founded the monastery of Llancarfan; the one rank its words support is martyr.
